purpose: Determine bounded ICV engagement closure independently from payment, deliverable acceptance, contract lifecycle COMPLETE, contract expiry, accounting close, legal discharge, repository state or runtime execution.

COMPLETE: all accepted engagement completion obligations are satisfied or explicitly resolved
no unresolved obligation belonging to the engagement remains
accountable offering owner records attributable closure evidence
COMPLETE_WITH_SUCCESSOR_OBLIGATION: original bounded engagement completion obligations are satisfied or explicitly resolved
one or more surviving/follow-on obligations are explicitly identified with type, scope, owner, trigger/due condition and evidence reference
successor obligation is not silently treated as work remaining inside the completed engagement
each successor obligation is classified through the successor-obligation handoff as original-terms continuation, amendment/renewal required, separate successor engagement required, or FAIL_CLOSED
recording/classifying a successor obligation does not authorize successor work
TERMINATED: authentic accepted termination/stop condition or authorized termination decision is evidenced
unperformed obligations and any surviving duties are explicitly identified
FAIL_CLOSED: exact engagement or closure owner cannot be authenticated
required completion/termination evidence is absent or contradictory
open obligation cannot be classified as resolved, successor, or terminated
successor obligation lacks an identified owner/scope/evidence basis

owner_refs: applicable offering fulfillment owner and exact accepted proposal/SOW
StegVerse-Labs/StegBusiness contracts canonical execution/amendment/renewal state references
StegVerse-Labs/StegBusiness-Ops contracts lifecycle DRAFT -> REVIEW_REQUIRED -> APPROVED_FOR_SIGNATURE -> EXECUTED -> ACTIVE -> AMENDED / RENEWAL_DUE -> EXPIRED / TERMINATED / COMPLETE
StegVerse-Labs/StegBusiness-Ops finance accounting-period close remains separate

non_equivalence.payment: PAYMENT_OBSERVED does not establish any closure disposition.
non_equivalence.deliverable_acceptance: CUSTOMER_DELIVERABLE_ACCEPTED does not establish any closure disposition.
non_equivalence.contract_expiry: EXPIRED is a StegBusiness-Ops contract lifecycle state and does not establish ICV engagement completion.
non_equivalence.contract_complete: StegBusiness-Ops COMPLETE is separately governed and neither automatically follows nor establishes ICV engagement COMPLETE.
non_equivalence.accounting_close: month/quarter/year close and revenue cut-off review do not establish engagement completion.
non_equivalence.repository: issue/PR/branch/repository closure does not establish engagement completion.
non_equivalence.legal: No closure disposition establishes legal discharge/enforceability.
non_equivalence.runtime: No closure disposition establishes software/runtime execution or authority.

source_closure_immutability: COMPLETE_WITH_SUCCESSOR_OBLIGATION remains the historical source-engagement closure disposition after any successor handoff.
